purpose: Shared mechanism vocabulary for a qualitative evidence crosswalk; labels identify mechanism types and do not rank systems.

cell_states.PAPER_CLAIM: Primary paper states or reports this mechanism; not independently reproduced here.
cell_states.CODE_OBSERVED: Mechanism is directly present in the pinned source paths inspected.
cell_states.DOC_CLAIM: Pinned official documentation describes the mechanism.
cell_states.PARTIAL: A bounded analogue, role, or related mechanism is present but does not establish the full construct.
cell_states.NOT_SHOWN: Not shown in the cited frozen artifacts and inspected scope; absence is scope-limited.
cell_states.NOT_APPLICABLE: The frozen source is a benchmark or artifact for which this mechanism is not an agent behavior.

mechanisms.definition: Capture task observations, executions, failures, or outcomes for later use.
Persist information so it can affect a later run or trial.
Select stored information and reintroduce it into later context or action.
Turn experience into a reusable executable behavior or skill artifact.
Retrieve, invoke, or compose a prior skill in a later task.
Synthesize prior experience into a textual or structured learning signal.
Generate feedback about an action, output, or candidate using an explicit critic role or check.
Change prompts, tools, control flow, or execution configuration as an improvement carrier.
Change or generate training/learning data as an improvement carrier.
Change model parameters or weights as an improvement carrier.
Measure candidate behavior against a declared metric, environment, or evaluator.
Use a protected evaluation partition or release authority outside candidate write/control surfaces.
Maintain a representation of the system’s own current capabilities, limits, or competence.
Detect or characterize a capability, frontier, or failure mode from observed behavior.
Restore a prior state or candidate when a change fails or is rejected.
Remove, deactivate, or reduce memory, skill, data, or scaffolding based on evidence.
Reduce stored/context representation while retaining selected information.
Mark an artifact as no longer eligible for use after evidence, drift, or replacement.
Choose which operator, tool, model, or improvement path acts next.
Change the procedure that creates, selects, evaluates, or updates improvements.
Show that a reusable artifact or improvement procedure transfers to a different model/provider.
Invalidate or refresh evidence when the system or evaluation target changes.
Keep evaluation/release authority or protected data outside candidate write surfaces.
Deduplicate, merge, generalize, or otherwise consolidate persistent memory.
Demonstrate that the improvement procedure, not only its outputs, works across tasks, models, or domains.

matrix_scope: Cells summarize only the frozen primary papers, official repository snapshots, documentation, and Task181-safe Pointfire source records listed in source-freeze.jsonl. NOT_SHOWN is limited to inspected scope. No external system was run.
